question: What is the concurrency of GLM-4.7-Flash on a new bigmodel.cn account, and does the API-key page or the new-user 20 million token pack ask for real-name authentication?
why: the per-model figure is on the login-gated rate-limits page (the console URL answers with the login page); third-party pages report a concurrency of 1 for the free tier but no first-party page states it, and third-party tutorials claim real-name is needed for a key while the platform FAQ says API calls do not require it
